documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Setco Automotive reported Q1 FY26 revenue from operations of Rs. 178.8 crore, representing a year-on-year growth of 7.8% driven by continued and robust product demand. EBITDA for Q1 FY26 stood at Rs. 21.6 crore, an increase of 11.9% year-on-year due to higher sales, a favourable segment mix, and improved operational efficiencies at Lava cast and foreign subsidiaries. For the full year FY25, revenue from operations reached Rs.

guidance.claim: MHCV industry is expected to grow at an exponential double-digit growth rate of over 30%.
guidance.quote: MHCV industry is expecting to grow at exponential double digit growth rate of >30%

guidance.claim: Setco sales to OEMs are estimated to be higher than the industry average due to BSVI channel and pipeline inventory restocking.
guidance.quote:
Setco sales to OEM’s estimated will be higher than the industry average due to
 BSVI Channel and pipeline inventory restocking/build-back
 Migration to larger size clutches (higher realization per unit) due to BS-VI norms

guidance.claim: The company expects 10 to 15% of its overall revenue to come from the tractor business going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward we are expecting 10-15% of our overall revenue to come from this segment

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue per unit increase of about 25% will remain going forward.
guidance.quote: Revenue per unit of ~25% will remain going forward

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in Q1 FY26 was attributed to continued and robust demand for Setco's products.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 178.8 crore in Q1 FY26, as against Rs. 165.8 crore in Q1 FY25, a growth of 7.8% on a year on year basis, mainly on account of continued and robust demand for Setco’s products

demand_outlook.claim: Market is now coming back strongly after Q1FY22 was subdued due to Covid wave-2.
demand_outlook.quote: While Q1FY22 has been subdued due to Covid wave-2, market is now coming back to strongly

demand_outlook.claim: Fleet utilization will progressively improve as the economy unlocks, resulting in higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket in coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: As economy gets unlocked, fleet utilization will progressively improve and long delayed repairs/over-hauling will be needed, resulting in higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket in coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects heavy allocation in budget for infrastructure, mining and rural sector to lead to sharp rebound in MHCV.
demand_outlook.quote: Due to heavy allocation in budget for infrastructure, mining and rural sector is expected to lead to sharp rebound in MHCV

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket segment saw strong order books with Q4FY21 demand described as the best ever.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue grew by ~12% in Q3FY21. Strong order book, Q4FY21 demand/order book is the best ever

demand_outlook.claim: Long overdue replacement of the past has started coming and is expected to continue for the foreseeable future.
demand_outlook.quote: Long overdue replacement of the past has started coming and expect to continue for the foreseeable future

demand_outlook.claim: Farm equipment supplies are expected to start with a few other OEMs in the next 3-4 months.
demand_outlook.quote: Farm equipment : Sales started with 2 OEM’s, expects to start with few others in next 3-4 months

capex_expansion.claim: Planned maintenance capex for Lava Cast is getting completed by H1FY22.
capex_expansion.quote: Due to liquidity issues, planned maintenance capex is getting completed by H1FY22 and would result in higher capacity utilization

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY26 EBITDA growth was driven by higher sales, favourable segment mix, and operational efficiencies at Lava cast and foreign subsidiaries.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the Q1 FY26 is Rs. 21.6 crore as against Rs. 19.3 crore in Q1 FY25, a year on year growth of 11.9%, mainly on account of higher sales, favourable segment mix and higher operational efficiencies at LAVA cast and Foreign subsidiaries

margins_costs.claim: Contribution levels reached 22.7% due to higher commodity prices and unfavorable segment mix.
margins_costs.quote: Contribution levels at 22.7% due to higher commodity prices and unfavorable segment mix.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins showed a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverages and a quarter lag on recovering raw material pricing.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins has shown a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverages and quarter lag on recovering RM pricing

margins_costs.claim: Fixed cost reduction and savings of over 24% have been achieved in the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: Already achieved Fixed cost reduction /savings of over ~24% in last two years

margins_costs.claim: Contribution margin in Q3FY21 stood at 28.2%, up by 50bps compared to 27.7% in Q3FY20.
margins_costs.quote: Contribution margin in Q3FY21 at28.2%up by 50bps as against 27.7%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved from 5% in Q3FY20 to 12.5% in Q3FY21, up by 750bps due to substantial reduction in fixed cost.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins improved from 5%in Q3FY20 to 12.5% in Q3FY21 up by 750bps (~INR 850 lakhs improvement), due to substantial reduction in fixed cost (down by ~18%)

margins_costs.claim: Fixed costs were on track to be brought down by over 20% over FY19.
margins_costs.quote: On track to bring down the fixed cost by ~>20% (~INR 18crs) over FY19

orders_capacity.claim: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with more than 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment.

orders_capacity.claim: Aftermarket sales declined by about 30% in FY21 with an unexecuted strong order book of approximately 6-8 months of sales.
orders_capacity.quote:
Aftermarket sales declined by ~30% in FY21 due to :
 Lower demand in Q1FY21 and while demand came back, supply side challenges continued in subsequent quarters
 Unexecuted strong order book approx. 6-8 months of sales

orders_capacity.claim: Setco retained its market leadership with over 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment

capital_allocation.claim: The investment proposal with India Resurgence Fund involves moving down the clutch business into subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through a slump-sale process via debentures, CCDs, and equity.
capital_allocation.quote:
The Investment Proposal involves moving down the clutch business of the company into the subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through BTA (slump-sale) process
 Investment will be in the combination of Debentures (NCDs), CCDs and Equity

capital_allocation.claim: Lava Cast's debt restructuring proposal was approved and implemented by the banks.
capital_allocation.quote: Restructuring proposal of bank has been approved and implemented

risks_headwinds.claim: FY21 saw a pandemic-induced crisis with frequent lockdowns, general economic slowdown, and fleet efficiency improvement due to GST and axle load norms.
risks_headwinds.quote:
Pandemic – induced crisis (Frequent Lockdowns)
 General economic slowdown
 Fleet efficiency improvement due to GST & additional 25% capacity due to Axle load norms

risks_headwinds.claim: Lava Cast faced teething problems including lower capacity utilization reaching a maximum of about 52% and high rejection rates of 17% to 19%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain constraints affected production during Q3FY21.
risks_headwinds.quote: Q3FY21 would have been much better, but supply chain constraint has affected the production

risks_headwinds.claim: Frequent lockdowns in foreign countries resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability for overseas subsidiaries.
risks_headwinds.quote: Frequent lockdown in foreign countries has resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability

management_commitments.claim: Expect to complete all formalities for the India Resurgence Fund deal in the next 7-15 days.
management_commitments.quote: Expect to complete all formalities in next 7-15 days.

management_commitments.claim: Farm tractor clutch business started with two OEMs and expects to add another 2-3 in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Farm Tractor clutches – Business started with two OEM’s viz Sonalika and Preet Tractors, expect to add another 2-3 in this financial year

management_commitments.claim: Efforts to rationalize fixed costs will continue in coming years, which will add to the bottom line.
management_commitments.quote: Our effortsrationalizingfixed cost will continuein coming years,whichwill addtothebottomline.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
